display.name: Phinix Example Plugin
display.summary: A simple example of plugin tabs, persistent settings and localization. Click the counter to explore the extension API; it does not create items or change your colony.
display.changelog: 1.0.2: upgrade acceptance release. Verify the update notice, explicit confirmation, restart activation and retained counter/settings when upgrading from 1.0.1. Example functionality is unchanged; no gameplay actions.

strings.intro: This example adds a tab through the public extension API. Try the counter below; it only changes this plugin’s own settings.
strings.persistence: The count stays after a restart or reinstall. Switch the game language to see localization in action.
strings.showHints: Show explanations in the example tab
strings.confirmReset: Reset this plugin’s click counter to zero? This only changes its own settings; your colony and save are unchanged.
